display_title: A God Is Better Than a Ghost
description:
As the second son of a shaman family, Su-Ho was born with insufficient yang energy and has been plagued by ghosts since childhood. He was able to be free from ghosts as long as he wore the family heirloom ring he received from his grandmother. However, on the first day of college, he lost the ring. He ran away from the ghosts that had started appearing again and found himself in an alley. There, he encountered a man wearing his ring…

 *“Give me back the ring.”

“I can’t give you the ring. I have to be with you.”*

Su-Ho is flustered by Shin-Woo, who uses the ring as a hostage and manipulates him as he pleases. It seems clear that they shouldn’t get involved any further—but why does he keep getting drawn to Shin-Woo? What will be the end of this strange relationship that started over a single ring?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
